card.name: Just before "ib" in split words
card.fires_on: The piece of a longer word right before an "ib" ending, such as the start of prescribed, inhibitors, celecoxib or imbibe. It is strongest in all-caps label text.

modes.label: Prescribe family
modes.description: Letters like CR or SCR just before "IBED" or "IBING" in describe and prescribe.
modes.example: FELBAMATE ORAL SUSPENSION SHOULD NOT BE PRE<<SCR>>IBED FOR ANYONE WITH A HISTORY

modes.label: Inhibitors
modes.description: The H or IN piece just before "IBITORS" in drug class names.
modes.example: WARNING: LONG-TERM SAFETY OF TOPICAL CALCINEURIN IN<<H>>IBITORS HAS NOT BEEN ESTABL

modes.label: Names ending in -ib
modes.description: The "cox" piece in celecoxib, right before "ib".
modes.example: The use of cele<<cox>>ib in patients with severe hepatic impairment

card.writes: It pushes the model to output the "ib" piece that completes the word.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a long word when the next piece is "ib", as in prescribe, inhibitor or celecoxib.
